_meta.description: Wave 2 state-coverage fence baseline. minLoadingSegments is a FLOOR (only raise it, via --write-baseline, after adding new segment loading.tsx files — never lower it by hand). emptyStateGaps grandfathers list-shaped pages (OpFilterBar signal) with no EmptyState signal in their own directory; curing a gap lets its entry be removed — new gaps not in this list fail lint:states.
